data.name: Veera
data.gender_notes: Veera is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is fearless and possesses great courage and strength. A warrior or hero. The name Veera carries the meaning “Brave, Strong, Fearless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Tamil. Parents who choose Veera usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong, fearless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who wish to embody the qualities of a fearless warrior, both in physical and spiritual battles.
data.etymology: Veera belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Strong, Fearless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Veera total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
